effect.en: Raises user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by two stages.  Lower user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

flavor.en: The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
flavor.ko: 껍질을 깨서 자신의 방어와 특수방어를 떨어뜨리지만 공격과 특수공격, 스피드를 크게 올린다.
